name: Fix Lag Super
description: Reduces lag and stutter in Geometry Dash: disables particles and shaders, forces low detail, cleans memory, removes camera shake.

disable-particles.name: Disable Particles
disable-particles.description: Stops drawing all particle effects while you are inside a level.

disable-shaders.name: Disable Shaders
disable-shaders.description: Ignores shader triggers (glitch, chromatic, pixelate, blur, bulge, etc.) when a level loads. Takes effect the next time you enter a level.

performance-mode.name: Force Low Detail Mode
performance-mode.description: Turns on GD's built-in Low Detail Mode while you are inside a level. Your normal setting is restored when you leave.

purge-on-load.name: Clean Memory Before Level Load
purge-on-load.description: Frees unused textures before a level loads to reduce stutter and memory pressure.

purge-on-quit.name: Clean Memory On Level Exit
purge-on-quit.description: Frees unused textures when you leave a level so lag does not build up over a long session.

disable-shake.name: Disable Camera Shake
disable-shake.description: Ignores camera shake triggers, which can cause frame drops in heavy levels.
